description: This file provides a utility function to parse JSON strings with a fallback to JSON5 parsing in case of failure. It helps handle JSON parsing robustly by first attempting standard JSON parsing and then trying JSON5.

methods.name: export function parseJsonWithJson5Fallback(raw: string): unknown { parseJsonWithJson5Fallback
methods.description: Parses a raw string as JSON, falling back to JSON5 parsing if JSON parsing fails.
